Round173D.genuine_interval_mellin_moment_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (mu : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts mu] (h chi : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hh : Continuous h) (hc : Continuous chi) (hs : HasCompactSupport h) (hu : ∀ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖chi x‖ = 1)
  (R alpha : ℝ) (_hR : 0 ≤ R) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hr : ∀ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), h x ≠ 0 → |classLog K x| ≤ R) (z : ℂ)
  (hz : |z.re| ≤ alpha) (m : ℕ) :
  Integrable (mellinMomentIntegrand K h chi z m) mu ∧
    ‖∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), mellinMomentIntegrand K h chi z m x ∂mu‖ ≤
      Real.exp (alpha * R) * R ^ m * ∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖h x‖ ∂mu
